title: syngonanthus xeranthemoides var. minor
intro: Syngonanthus xeranthemoides var. minor, commonly known as Brazilian peppermint, is a species of plant in the family Eriocaulaceae. It is an herb used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Amazon region. The health benefits of Brazilian peppermint include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Brazilian peppermint include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties.
